subject: Renewal: EU onboarding + APAC warm-standby — SLA & residency updates
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@lumencare.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Nov 2028 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal: EU onboarding + APAC warm-standby — SLA & residency updates

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the thoughtful conversation last week. Per our renewal cadence, LumenCare's contract comes up for renewal on 2029-01-15; we'd like to bundle the EU region onboarding and an APAC warm-standby entitlement into the renewal (single amendment + SOW) to avoid a separate procurement cycle.

Quick summary of what we propose:
- EU onshore tenancy (data residency + audit scope) for primary traffic in scope by Q1 2029
- APAC warm-standby for burst capacity and failover (hot-standby nodes in APAC region, activation window for traffic spikes)
- A 20% uplift on committed capacity for three months as a staged ramp (to support your expected Q2 marketing push)
- SLA: keep existing 99.9% with an operational runbook and dedicated onboarding sprint; propose a limited credit carve-out for mid-migration variance

Attached: draft SOW (SOW-regional-burst.xlsx) for the rollout plan and a short checklist for legal (evidence we typically see helps speed review). I've included a straw-man amendment for terms to reflect residency commitments — happy to iterate.

Could you share:
- expected monthly token/embedding volume for Jan–Jun 2029 (projection ranges are fine)
- any specific data residency language your legal team requires beyond standard EU onshore wording
- any internal procurement timelines we should hit to get DocuSign signed before 2029-01-15

If it helps, we can run a 30-min alignment call (internal ops + your security/legal) this week.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate internally after your reply.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0127

Attachments: SOW-regional-burst.xlsx (spreadsheet), checklist.pdf (attachment stub)
From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@lumencare.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Evans <tom.evans@lumencare.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Nov 2028 17:05:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: EU onboarding + APAC warm-standby — SLA & residency updates

Hi Kimberly —

Appreciate the clear summary. A few notes from our side:

1) Volume: rough projection for Jan–Jun 2029 is 75M–120M tokens/month and ~40k embeddings/month (spikes expected May–June). We can provide a more detailed spreadsheet by EOD Wednesday.

2) Residency: our legal team requires a data fence commitment (no cross-border processing for EU primary traffic, plus an audit timeline for evidence). Can you confirm: will the EU tenancy be single-tenant for our workload or multi-tenant with cryptographic isolation?

3) Procurement: we need signed amendments before 2029-01-10 to hit our FY procurement close. Legal flagged the SLA credit window; they typically prefer reduced carve-outs.

We'd like pricing and the amendment draft to be reasonably final before we send to procurement. Also please include any runbook/ops expectations for failover activation (we need a 30-minute maximum activation window documented).

Happy to jump on a call Thursday morning CET (my timezone) if that helps.

—Sara
Sara Lin
Head of Platform Engineering | LumenCare Systems
sara.lin@lumencare.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Nov 2028 10:40:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Renewal: EU onboarding + APAC warm-standby — SLA & residency updates

Priyom / Marissa — forwarding LumenCare reply. Key asks:
- Confirm EU tenancy model: they want clarity on single-tenant vs multi-tenant with crypto isolation (we normally offer single-tenant for reserved Dedicated customers, but Hosted + private tenancy combos possible)
- Volume projection (75M–120M tokens/mo) — we should propose a 12-month committed baseline with a 3-month uplift crediting window for the staged ramp; include burst blocks for 50% of projected spike capacity in May–June
- SLA carve-out: legal dislikes broad carve-outs — propose a narrow mid-migration variance (max 0.1% extra window) or an alternative credit schedule
- Ops ask: 30-minute activation window for APAC failover must be documented in runbook and tested during onboarding sprint

Propose Priyom draft an amendment with two options: (A) single-tenant EU + APAC warm-standby (higher price); (B) multi-tenant EU w/ crypto-fencing + APAC warm-standby (lower price). Marissa — can you draft a short runbook excerpt that states activation steps and test plan?

Target: send both amendment options + SOW and a DocuSign link by Thu 2028-11-30 COB so LumenCare legal can review Friday.

Kim

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Nov 2028 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal: EU onboarding + APAC warm-standby — SLA & residency updates

Kim / Marissa —

I've drafted two amendment options and attached Draft_AMENDMENT_v3.pdf (v3 reflects reduced credit carve-out and explicit audit window for EU residency). Highlights:
- Option A (Single-tenant EU): +18% list uplift on committed baseline; includes dedicated tenancy + annual audit rights; APAC warm-standby included at 10% of committed capacity with 60-day emergency top-up
- Option B (Crypto-fenced Multi-tenant EU): +10% uplift; cryptographic separation for KV and customer data; limited audit evidence (log tails + attestation) rather than full on-prem audit
- Proposed SLA adjustment: keep 99.9% but remove broad mid-migration carve-outs; instead offer a one-time migration variance allowance (0.1% for a 30-day window) and a 5% credit for breaches beyond that
- Pricing: proposed committed baseline 90M tokens/mo (matches client mid-range) with three-month 20% staged uplift credit applied to first quarter of ramp

I've also created a DocuSign envelope (link below) with Option A pre-selected; we can swap to Option B on the DocuSign form if LumenCare prefers.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/ABC-92531
Attachment: Draft_AMENDMENT_v3.pdf

Marissa — can you paste the runbook snippet here? I'll fold into the SOW.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@lumencare.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Evans <tom.evans@lumencare.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Nov 2028 16:05:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: EU onboarding + APAC warm-standby — SLA & residency updates

Hi Kimberly / Priyom —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the two options. Our legal and platform teams looked at Draft_AMENDMENT_v3 and prefer Option A (single-tenant EU). A few final asks before we sign:

- Can we narrow the migration variance window to a 21-day window instead of 30?
- Request minor language change in Section 4.2 (audit evidence delivery: change "30 days" to "45 days" for delivery after a formal request)
- Please confirm that APAC warm-standby activation testing will be completed during onboarding sprint and provide a proposed test date (we prefer week of 2029-02-05)

If you can make these 3 small edits, we'll route Option A to procurement and expect to sign the DocuSign envelope on Monday.

Once signed, let's schedule a 60-minute kickoff with Platform + Ops — Kimberly, can you propose two available slots next week?

Best,
Sara

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@lumencare.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Sara —

Thanks — we'll make the three small edits (reduce migration window to 21 days, change audit evidence delivery to 45 days, confirm APAC test week of 2029-02-05). I'll update the DocuSign envelope and ping you with two kickoff slots for next week (Wed 09:00 CET or Thu 14:00 CET).

Looking forward to closing this out early next week.

Cheers,
Kim
